Document: # Rule 3.1 Do not intentionally prepare for unrealistic scenarios unless you have proper in-character reasoning, especially if it is intended to gain an upper-hand or advantage over another player. AFTERLIGHT has a heavy focus on roleplay; you should generally prioritize this over playing to win. - This is commonly referred to as "powergaming". - Minor violations—such as acquiring a crowbar at the start of a round—are not considered powergaming. Contrastingly, seeking out a weapon when no threat is present is considered powergaming. - Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) dictates how different departments and jobs should behave in various scenarios. SOP can be viewed in the guidebook.
